1.e4 c6 2.Nc3 d5 3.Nf3 dxe4 4.Ng5.strategy: Attacks e4 a second time and eyes f7, hoping to win the pawn back. But the knight moves twice in the opening, and the pawn could simply have been regained with Nxe4, so the move offers little over the normal recapture.
1.e4 c6 2.Nc3 d5 3.Nf3 dxe4 4.Ng5.name: Caro–Kann Defence: Hector Gambit
